narrative: Cobot's second-generation Proxie launch validates the mechanism: it anchored the reveal on a quantified production record -- 12,627 operating hours, 40 million pounds moved, 17 million steps saved -- and priced at $5,000 per month, so subscription billing makes audited hours-in-operation the unit vendors compete and underwrite on, exactly the pivot from show-floor clips this thesis names.
remaining_gap: A single-platform 12,627-hour figure sits an order of magnitude below the six-figure cross-customer fleet bar; no vendor frames 100,000-plus hours as a metric yet.
